frame: X forward, Y port, Z up; origin = centreline x hull mid-length x keel bottom

parts.name: energy_container
parts.note: ENERGY_REQ_155 overpressure valve aft, 56 fire port to port, 189 external charge interface, 171-173 labels, 182 sensor pass-through to the pack core

parts.name: pdu
parts.note: fuse feed, main and precharge contactors, HV interlock. ENERGY_REQ_60 and 63 satisfied by one lid

parts.name: main_contactor
parts.note: ENERGY_REQ_79: opened by the E-stop through a relay, not software

parts.name: precharge_contactor
parts.note: without it the main contactor welds onto the DC-link capacitance

parts.name: inverter
parts.note: NOT SELECTED -- Competr lists it on request. Envelope reservation

parts.name: terminal_box
parts.note: HV terminal box on the container lid, over the pack terminals. Holds the main fuse and the shunt so ENERGY_REQ_58 is satisfied by geometry rather than by argument

parts.name: main_fuse
parts.note: 400 A. ENERGY_REQ_58 immediately after the storage; 59 below every conductor it protects

parts.name: current_shunt
parts.note: feeds the BMS and the Annex III telemetry current channel

parts.name: dcdc
parts.note: HV to 12 V. Also supplies the ENERGY_REQ_184 organiser interface

parts.name: heat_exchanger
parts.note: seawater plate exchanger -- the sea is the ultimate heat sink

parts.name: lv_battery
parts.note: ENERGY_REQ_7 note 3 exempts it from the energy sum; 58 still requires it fused and 67 still requires its temperature monitored

parts.name: vcu
parts.note: Competr control unit, IP67, datasheet section 2

parts.name: estop
parts.note: ENERGY_REQ_76 red on a 90 mm yellow circle, 77 >=30 mm button, 81 starboard and forward of the pilot, 85 within 1 m of starboard, 86 facing outboard

parts.name: bulkhead
parts.note: ENERGY_REQ_50/51/52. A1 fire rated. One 40 mm grommeted pass-through (174: >=30, 175: <=50)

parts.name: monitor_bay
parts.note: ENERGY_REQ_185 free volume, ON the crown so it is open to the sky and outside every closed compartment

parts.name: outboard
parts.note: 26.9 kW nominal, capped to 25 kW by ENERGY_REQ_188

parts.name: drive_leg
parts.note: transom bracket and hydraulic trim assembly, datasheet section 7

cables.name: hv_pack_pos
cables.note: pack terminal straight up into the fused terminal box

cables.name: hv_pack_neg
cables.note: pack terminal straight up into the fused terminal box

cables.name: hv_fused_to_pdu
cables.note: downstream of the fuse, so this is the first protected run

cables.name: hv_pdu_to_inverter
cables.note: PDU to the inverter DC input

cables.name: phase_U
cables.note: screened three-phase. Descends monotonically: no climb over the outboard, because a hairpin there cannot meet the bend radius

cables.name: phase_V
cables.note: screened three-phase. Descends monotonically: no climb over the outboard, because a hairpin there cannot meet the bend radius

cables.name: phase_W
cables.note: screened three-phase. Descends monotonically: no climb over the outboard, because a hairpin there cannot meet the bend radius
